> *Parts that come into contact with food (gaskets, lids, body blanks, and any other item marked food-contact in the item master) may be bought only from a supplier holding a **valid food-grade certificate** on file in Bahi.*

The 5-litre gasket (`GSK-SIL-05L`) is classified as a food-contact item in Bahi. Even if the supplier offers a significantly better price, company policy strictly prohibits placing orders for food-contact parts with any supplier that lacks a valid, verified food-grade certificate on file. 

If we wish to purchase from this supplier, they must first provide a valid food-grade certificate, which must be uploaded and verified in Bahi before any order can be placed.
